summary: Tested the reworked /products page (ORQYNE) end-to-end on the preview URL: backend pilot-lead API and frontend UI (desktop 1920 and mobile 390). Every item in the review request passes. (1) Page title 'ORQYNE: AI Project Management and Delivery Governance'. (2) Hero shows the positioning line and the headline. product-pilot-btn goes to #pilot. product-trial-btn, path-trial-btn, pilot-trial-link and agents-capabilities-btn open https://orgainse.live in a new tab (new-tab navigation verified). (3) All 13 sections render in the required order. (4) Principles 0..2 have the correct titles. (5) The experience tabs switch: IT shows 'Key outcomes' with 5 bullets, Canvas shows 6 function areas, and the pilot-intent label follows the tab. (6) Pillars plan/execute/understand/govern/connect are present. (7) Implementation heading and the Prepare/Validate/Configure/Operate steps are present. (8) RAG shows Index/Retrieve/Generate/Review plus the 'may contain errors' sentence. (9) 7 agents including Custom Agents; 6 connectors with the 'confirmed before purchase' note; all 5 collaboration chips. (10) 4 plans, each 'Contact Sales' button goes to #pilot, no prices, and the pricing statement includes support@orgainse.com. (11) Security heading with 6 controls; the compliance disclaimer sentence is in FAQ answer 6. (12) The FAQ has exactly 9 questions in the specified order. All 9 answers are in the DOM (hidden attribute) and clicking toggles them open and closed. (13) Final CTA and the pilot-no-guarantee text are present. (14) Pilot form: name, email, organisation, team-size chip 51–200, Canvas experience chip and scope submitted. API returned 200, pilot-success-message appeared, and the form reset. The lead showed in Admin under 'ORQYNE Pilot Requests' with the correct team size, experience and scope, and was then deleted by id. (15) Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 380 ≤ 390). (16) 'Earned Value' is gone from Home, Services and Products, but only after a frontend restart (see RCA).

minor.issue: A non-existent leadId returns 200 with success:false instead of 404. This is existing behaviour; the test was adjusted to match.

ui_bugs.issue: `submitted` is never reset. After one successful submit, a later failed submit shows the error toast while the green 'Request received' message stays on screen, which is contradictory. Call setSubmitted(false) at the start of submit or in the catch block.
The testid for the '200+' chip resolves to 'pilot-team-size-200' because the '200-plus' fallback is dead code (the regex leaves '200'). It works, but the name is misleading.

issues: The Implementation and RAG sections are adjacent and both use bg-slate-50 with border-y. They read as one block with a double border; alternate RAG to white for rhythm.

action_items: Optional: reset `submitted` to false on each new pilot submit attempt, or on error.
Optional: give the RAG section a white background so it does not merge with the Implementation section.

Remember: after editing public/index.html, the CRA dev server keeps serving the old HTML until `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`. Also rebuild the prerendered build/ (yarn build), because the old 'Earned Value Management' text existed in the stale served HTML.
critical_code_review_comments: Products.js is 893 lines (>700). Move the PLANS/AGENTS/CONNECTORS/SECURITY/FAQS data arrays into src/content/orqyne.js.

The pilot form's 'Operating experience' chips share state with the top experience tabs (setActiveExp). Choosing Canvas in the form also switches the page section above. This is acceptable, but it couples UI and form data.

The SoftwareApplication JSON-LD 'offers' entries have no price or priceCurrency. Google may report 'Missing field price' warnings in Search Console. Consider dropping offers or using a priceSpecification-less Offer only in combination with 'priceValidUntil'; otherwise accept the warnings.

contact.js awaits notifyPilot (Resend) inside the request path. Failures are caught (verified: the lead saves and the API returns 200 while the Resend key is invalid), but a slow Resend call delays the response.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (2 low-priority UX nits)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted by id: pilot lead 1795066602530-pc9hhmdn05h (qa-pilot-ui@example.com, UI test), plus 2 API-test pilot leads that the pytest fixtures and the test itself deleted. Older TEST pilot leads from previous iterations (it12/it13, e.g. 'TEST it13 pilot', 'test_it12_ui_pilot_*@example.com') remain in orqyne_pilot_leads. I did not create them, so I did not delete them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_products_orqyne_iter23.py -p no:xdist` with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Admin: support@orgainse.com / QaTest!2026#Org. The admin ORQYNE tab is data-testid=admin-tab-orqyne_pilots. Pilot email via Resend fails (invalid key, known blocker) and is logged as 'ORQYNE pilot email error'; this is expected. The frontend was restarted once in this iteration to pick up the updated public/index.html.
rca of the issue: 'Earned Value Management' was still in the Organization JSON-LD knowsAbout on / and /services, even though public/index.html (edited at 05:34) no longer contained it. Cause: the CRA dev server (HtmlWebpackPlugin) kept serving the old in-memory index.html. After `supervisorctl restart frontend`, curl on / and /services returns 0 matches. No code change was needed.
